sprintName: Authentication, Academic Honor Gate & Role Architecture
goals: Implement Academic Honor Code & Terms Acceptance Gate before account creation
Provide default seeded demo accounts for rapid testing

issues.title: [Auth] Student & Faculty Registration with Mandatory Terms & Privacy Compliance Acceptance Modal
issues.description: Implement registration UI and API enforcing acceptance of Academic Honor Code and Terms & Conditions before user creation proceeds. Support role selection ('faculty' vs 'student') and capture student year level and section.

issues.title: [Auth] Secure JWT Authentication & Role-Based Access Control
issues.description: Implement secure password hashing via bcrypt, JWT token signing/verification, login endpoint, and current authenticated user retrieval endpoint (/api/auth/me) with role guard middleware.

issues.title: [Auth] Database Seeding for Default Faculty & Student Demo Accounts
issues.description: Implement database seeder creating default demo faculty (faculty@quikz.edu) and student (student@quikz.edu) accounts with pre-configured credentials for immediate evaluation and test coverage.
